profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I enjoy using technology in thoughtful ways to eliminate complexity from the world! I'm passionate about building cool things, usually with Python, but also enjoy collecting and analyzing data.

positions.title: Python Software Developer
positions.description:
- Built web applications using Python to enable compliance monitoring for large scale manufacturing projects.
- Deployed a data pipeline to AWS using Python, Docker, and SQLAlchemy to ingest third-party data files.
- Scaled a report generation process by automating data ingestion, review processes, and PDF report creation.
- Supported new developer onboarding by maintaining and driving adoption of a team wiki in GitHub.
- Developed and maintained several internal dependencies to reduce development time.
- Collaborated with 5 other developers using git, implemented automated testing and linting with GitHub Actions.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Developed a statistical model in Python to classify more than 50,000 attendance rates into 3 categories.
- Collaborated with school faculty to review and analyze test score data to prioritize classroom instruction.
- Frequently analyzed and visualized complex testing results of 4 subjects at more than 50 schools using R.

positions.title: Optimization Consultant
positions.description:
- Built a live dashboard in Google Sheets to track mission critical KPIs across 24 events in 4 states.
- Automated a scheduling application using Google Apps Script to save 10 hrs of manual work per week.
- Used the Google Sheets API and Python to streamline recruitment efforts of over 400 employees.

positions.title: Advanced Analytics Intern
positions.description:
- Consulted closely with SMEs to scope, brainstorm, and implement a forecasted distribution of  profitability.
- Synthesized unstructured data sources to design and build a Monte Carlo simulation model in Python.
- Used Python, R, and SAS to clean, merge, analyze, and summarize over 50 million rows of data.
- Delivered data driven hiring and relocation insights by modeling$60 million worth of incremental sales.
- Investigated and presented share of wallet variability using Rshiny to inform strategic sales tactics.
- Worked on a cross-functional team to deploy a floor space optimization tool and recommender system.

positions.title: Statistical Consultant
positions.description:
Working with clients in the Grand Valley community to offer statistical advice, perform analyses, and interpret results.
   - Fit models using SAS, SPSS, python, and R
   - Communicated results to clients in an easy to understand matter
   - Delivered relevant outputs in many different file formats adhering to publication standards

positions.title: Statistics Tutor
positions.description:
Helping fellow students gain an understanding of basic statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, linear regression, and analysis of variance.
   - Troubleshooting issues with statistical packages such as R, SPSS, SAS, and python
   - Understood and leveraged student learning styles to communicate in the most effective manner
   - Solidified my own understanding of the core ideas of statistical methodology
